facts.quote: a coffered concrete dome made from Roman concrete (also called opus caementicium ), with a central opening
facts.statement: The rotunda dome is coffered on its interior and pierced by one central oculus opening at the crown.

facts.quote: large granite Corinthian columns (eight in the first rank and two groups of four behind)
facts.statement: The portico colonnade is octastyle: eight columns in the first rank with two groups of four columns behind them.

facts.quote: The building is round in plan, except for the portico with large granite Corinthian columns (eight in the first rank and two groups of four behind) under a pediment
facts.statement: The portico must be crowned by a triangular pediment carrying a pitched (gabled) roof form; a flat slab roof does not satisfy the adopted precedent.
